  68    @staticmethod
  69    def mark_diffs(
  70        score1: m21.stream.Score,
  71        score2: m21.stream.Score,
  72        op_list: list[DiffOperation]
  73    ) -> None:
  74        '''
  75        Mark up two music21 scores with the differences described by an operations
  76        list (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
  77
  78        Args:
  79            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score to mark up
  80            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score to mark up
  81            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
  82                between the two scores
  83        '''
  84        Visualization._visualize_op_list(
  85            op_list,
  86            score1,
  87            score2,
  88            'draw'
  89        )

  91    @staticmethod
  92    def _draw_diffs(
  93        op: DiffOperation,
  94        score1: m21.stream.Score,
  95        score2: m21.stream.Score,
  96        # the next set of params are only for drawing in the score (used here)
  97        opname: str = '',  # must be 'inserted', 'deleted', 'changed'
  98        custom_text: str = '',  # replaces opname + name + sub_name
  99        # (e.g. 'changed grace note' instead of 'changed' + 'note' + 'grace')
 100        color_accidental_too: bool = False,
 101        # the next set of params are for both types of visualization
 102        name: str = '',  # name of object
 103        sub_name: str = '',  # e.g. 'content' or 'sym'
 104    ) -> list[str]:
 105        if name == 'metadata':
 106            # someday we will draw some of the metadata changes
 107            return []
 108
 109        m21_obj1: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 110        m21_obj2: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 111        m21_obj1, m21_obj2 = op.get_m21_objs()
 112
 113        note_idx1: int | None = None
 114        note_idx2: int | None = None
 115        if op.indexes is not None:
 116            # we have pitch indexes within an AnnNote (which is a Chord)
 117            if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 118                if op.obj1 is not None and op.obj2 is None:
 119                    note_idx1 = op.indexes
 120                elif op.obj1 is None and op.obj2 is not None:
 121                    note_idx2 = op.indexes
 122                else:
 123                    raise ValueError(
 124                        'invalid call to _draw_diffs: one note_idx, but two (or zero) chords'
 125                    )
 126            else:
 127                assert isinstance(op.indexes, tuple)
 128                assert len(op.indexes) == 2
 129                assert isinstance(op.indexes[0], int)
 130                assert isinstance(op.indexes[1], int)
 131                note_idx1 = op.indexes[0]
 132                note_idx2 = op.indexes[1]
 133        else:
 134            # This is an AnnNote that is a Note within a Chord.
 135            if isinstance(op.obj1, AnnNote) and op.obj1.is_in_chord:
 136                if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 137                    assert isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 138                note_idx1 = op.obj1.note_idx_in_chord
 139                if not name:
 140                    if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 141                        assert isinstance(note_idx1, int)
 142                    name = m21_obj1.notes[note_idx1].classes[0]
 143            if isinstance(op.obj2, AnnNote) and op.obj2.is_in_chord:
 144                if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 145                    assert isinstance(m21_obj2, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 146                note_idx2 = op.obj2.note_idx_in_chord
 147                if not name:
 148                    if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 149                        assert isinstance(note_idx2, int)
 150                    name = m21_obj2.notes[note_idx2].classes[0]
 151
 152        if sub_name in ('symbolic', 'content', 'info'):
 153            # e.g. "changed Barline symbolic" should actually be "changed Barline"
 154            # e.g. "changed TextExpression content" should actually be "changed TextExpression"
 155            # e.g. "changed KeySignature info" should actually be "changed KeySignature"
 156            sub_name = ''
 157        elif sub_name == 'style':
 158            styledict1: dict[str, str] = {}
 159            styledict2: dict[str, str] = {}
 160            if op.obj1 is not None:
 161                styledict1 = op.obj1.styledict
 162            if op.obj2 is not None:
 163                styledict2 = op.obj2.styledict
 164            change_str: str = Visualization._dict_change_str(styledict1, styledict2)
 165            if change_str:
 166                sub_name = change_str
 167
 168        if m21_obj1 is not None:
 169            obj1_text: str = custom_text
 170            if not obj1_text:
 171                # opname + name + sub_name
 172                obj1_text = name
 173                if not obj1_text:
 174                    obj1_text = m21_obj1.classes[0]
 175                if sub_name:
 176                    obj1_text += ' ' + sub_name
 177                obj1_text = opname + ' ' + obj1_text
 178            Visualization._draw_diff(
 179                m21_obj1,
 180                text=obj1_text,
 181                color=Visualization.COLOR_FOR_OPNAME[opname],
 182                note_idx=note_idx1,
 183                color_accidental_too=color_accidental_too
 184            )
 185
 186        if m21_obj2 is not None:
 187            obj2_text: str = custom_text
 188            if not obj2_text:
 189                # opname + name + sub_name
 190                obj2_text = name
 191                if not obj2_text:
 192                    obj2_text = m21_obj2.classes[0]
 193                if sub_name:
 194                    obj2_text += ' ' + sub_name
 195                obj2_text = opname + ' ' + obj2_text
 196            Visualization._draw_diff(
 197                m21_obj2,
 198                text=obj2_text,
 199                color=Visualization.COLOR_FOR_OPNAME[opname],
 200                note_idx=note_idx2,
 201                color_accidental_too=color_accidental_too
 202            )
 203
 204        return []  # ignored by callers
 205
 206    @staticmethod
 207    def _draw_diff(
 208        m21_obj: m21.base.Music21Object,
 209        text: str,
 210        color: str,
 211        note_idx: int | None = None,
 212        color_accidental_too: bool = False
 213    ):
 214        # Create (and color) text expression, and insert it as requested
 215        textExp = m21.expressions.TextExpression(text)
 216        textExp.style.color = color
 217
 218        insert_in_stream: m21.stream.Stream | None = None
 219        insert_at_offset: OffsetQL | None = None
 220        if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Stream):
 221            if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Part):
 222                # insert at beginning of the first Measure of Part
 223                insert_in_stream = m21_obj[m21.stream.Measure].first()
 224                insert_at_offset = 0.
 225            else:
 226                # insert at beginning of the stream
 227                insert_in_stream = m21_obj
 228                insert_at_offset = 0.
 229        elif isinstance(m21_obj, m21.spanner.Spanner):
 230            spannerFirst: m21.base.Music21Object = m21_obj.getFirst()
 231            if isinstance(spannerFirst, m21.stream.Part):
 232                # spannerFirst is a Part, put the textExp at beginning
 233                # of the first Measure in the Part
 234                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst[m21.stream.Measure].first()
 235                insert_at_offset = 0.
 236            elif isinstance(spannerFirst, m21.stream.Stream):
 237                # spannerFirst is a Stream, put the textExp at beginning
 238                # of the Stream
 239                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst
 240                insert_at_offset = 0.
 241            else:
 242                # spannerFirst is not a Stream, put the textExp right next to it.
 243                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst.activeSite
 244                insert_at_offset = spannerFirst.offset
 245        else:
 246            # neither Stream nor Spanner, put the textExp right next to it.
 247            insert_in_stream = m21_obj.activeSite
 248            insert_at_offset = m21_obj.offset
 249
 250        if insert_in_stream is not None and insert_at_offset is not None:
 251            insert_in_stream.insert(insert_at_offset, textExp)
 252        else:
 253            # should never happen, but might if the code above is modified.
 254            raise ValueError('stream or offset of descriptive text is unknown.')
 255
 256        # Now color the m21_obj with the requested color
 257        if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Stream):
 258            # m21_obj is a Score or Part or Measure or Voice...
 259            # Color every note and rest in that stream, recursively.
 260            # Don't bother with accidentals (we don't bother with
 261            # extras either, for that matter).
 262            for el in m21_obj.recurse().notesAndRests:
 263                el.style.color = color
 264        elif note_idx is not None:
 265            if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 266                specified_note: m21.note.GeneralNote = m21_obj.notes[note_idx]
 267                specified_note.style.color = color
 268                if color_accidental_too and hasattr(specified_note, 'pitch'):
 269                    if specified_note.pitch.accidental:
 270                        specified_note.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 271            else:
 272                # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 273                # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 274                # Don't crash by looking for notes, just color whatever the
 275                # non-Chord object is.
 276                m21_obj.style.color = color
 277                if color_accidental_too and hasattr(m21_obj, 'pitch'):
 278                    if m21_obj.pitch.accidental:
 279                        m21_obj.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 280        else:
 281            m21_obj.style.color = color
 282            if color_accidental_too and hasattr(m21_obj, 'pitch'):
 283                if m21_obj.pitch.accidental:
 284                    m21_obj.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 285
 286    @staticmethod
 287    def _dict_change_str(dict1: dict[str, str], dict2: dict[str, str]) -> str:
 288        # returns a comma-delimited list of differing keys (either missing in
 289        # one of the dictionaries, or existing in both but with different values).
 290        change_str: str = ''
 291        for k1, v1 in dict1.items():
 292            if k1 not in dict2 or dict2[k1] != v1:
 293                if change_str:
 294                    change_str += ','
 295                change_str += k1
 296        # one last thing: check for keys in dict2 that aren't in dict1
 297        for k2 in dict2:
 298            if k2 not in dict1:
 299                if change_str:
 300                    change_str += ','
 301                change_str += k2
 302        return change_str
 303
 304    @staticmethod
 305    def show_diffs(
 306        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 307        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 308        out_path1: str | Path | None = None,
 309        out_path2: str | Path | None = None
 310    ) -> None:
 311        '''
 312        Render two (presumably marked-up) music21 scores.  If both out_path1 and
 313        out_path2 are not None, save the rendered PDFs at those two locations,
 314        otherwise just display them using the default PDF viewer on the system.
 315
 316        Args:
 317            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score to render
 318            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score to render
 319            out_path1 (str, Path): Where to save the first marked-up rendered score PDF.
 320                If out_path1 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
 321                (default is None)
 322            out_path2 (str, Path): Where to save the second marked-up rendered score PDF.
 323                If out_path2 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
 324                (default is None)
 325        '''
 326        # display the two (presumably annotated) scores
 327
 328        # avoid some crashes during write()/show() operations
 329        from converter21 import M21Utilities
 330        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score1, inPlace=True)
 331        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score2, inPlace=True)
 332
 333        originalComposer1: str | None = None
 334        originalComposer2: str | None = None
 335
 336        if score1.metadata is None:
 337            score1.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
 338        if score2.metadata is None:
 339            score2.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
 340
 341        originalComposer1 = score1.metadata.composer
 342        if originalComposer1 is None:
 343            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1'
 344        else:
 345            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1          ' + originalComposer1
 346
 347        originalComposer2 = score2.metadata.composer
 348        if originalComposer2 is None:
 349            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2'
 350        else:
 351            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2          ' + originalComposer2
 352
 353        # save files if requested
 354        if (out_path1 is not None) and (out_path2 is not None):
 355            score1.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path1)
 356            score2.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path2)
 357            print(f'Annotated scores saved in {out_path1} and {out_path2}.', file=sys.stderr)
 358        else:
 359            # just display the scores
 360            score1.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)
 361            score2.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)
 362
 363    @staticmethod
 364    def _location_of(m21obj: m21.base.Music21Object, score: m21.stream.Score) -> str:
 365        output: str
 366        meas: m21.stream.Stream | None
 367        part: m21.stream.Stream | None
 368        staffNum: int
 369        fractionalBeats: OffsetQL
 370
 371        if isinstance(m21obj, (m21.metadata.Metadata, m21.layout.StaffGroup)):
 372            # These are not in the timeline.  Put them first (there may be a
 373            # a measure 0/staff 0, but the first beat of that measure is beat 1).
 374            output = 'measure 0, staff 0, beat 0.0'
 375            return output
 376
 377        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.spanner.RepeatBracket):
 378            # spans measures, location is start of first measure in RepeatBracket
 379            meas = m21obj.getFirst()
 380            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 381                return ''
 382            part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 383            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 384                return ''
 385            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 386            staffNum += 1  # staff number is 1-based
 387            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 388            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 389            fractionalBeats = 1.
 390            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 391            return output
 392
 393        # part
 394        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Part):
 395            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(m21obj, score)
 396            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 397            output = 'measure 0, '
 398            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 399            fractionalBeats = 1.
 400            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 401            return output
 402
 403        # measure
 404        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Measure):
 405            part = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 406            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 407                return ''
 408            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 409            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 410            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(m21obj, part)}, '
 411            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 412            fractionalBeats = 1.
 413            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 414            return output
 415
 416        # voice
 417        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Voice):
 418            meas = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 419            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 420                return ''
 421            part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 422            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 423                return ''
 424            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 425            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 426            voiceStartOffset: OffsetQL = m21obj.getOffsetInHierarchy(meas)
 427            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 428            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 429            ts: m21.meter.TimeSignature | None = m21obj.getContextByClass(m21.meter.TimeSignature)
 430            if ts is None:
 431                ts = m21.meter.TimeSignature()  # 4/4
 432            fractionalBeats = M21Utils.get_beats(voiceStartOffset, ts)
 433            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 434            return output
 435
 436        # spanner
 437        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.spanner.Spanner):
 438            first: m21.base.Music21Object | None = m21obj.getFirst()
 439            if first is None:
 440                return ''
 441            m21obj = first
 442            # fall through to handle normal non-stream/non-spanner m21obj
 443
 444        # normal object (not stream, not spanner)
 445        container: m21.stream.Stream | None = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 446        if isinstance(container, m21.stream.Measure):
 447            meas = container
 448        elif isinstance(container, m21.stream.Voice):
 449            meas = score.containerInHierarchy(container)
 450            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 451                return ''
 452        else:
 453            return ''
 454
 455        part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 456        if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 457            return ''
 458        staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 459        staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 460        startOffset: OffsetQL = m21obj.getOffsetInHierarchy(meas)
 461        output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 462        output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 463        ts = m21obj.getContextByClass(m21.meter.TimeSignature)
 464        if ts is None:
 465            ts = m21.meter.TimeSignature()  # 4/4
 466        fractionalBeats = M21Utils.get_beats(startOffset, ts)
 467        output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 468        return output

 470    READABLE_STR_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {
 471        'dur': 'duration'
 472    }

 474    @staticmethod
 475    def _text_diff(
 476        op: DiffOperation,
 477        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 478        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 479        # the next set of params are only for drawing in the score (used here)
 480        opname: str = '',  # must be 'inserted', 'deleted', 'changed'
 481        custom_text: str = '',
 482        color_accidental_too: bool = False,
 483        # the next set of params are only for diff-like text output (unused here)
 484        name: str = '',  # name of object
 485        sub_name: str = '',  # e.g. 'content' or 'sym'
 486    ) -> list[str]:
 487        outputList: list[str] = []
 488        oneOutput: str  # one string, multiple lines (with \n at end of all but last line)
 489
 490        m21_obj1: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 491        m21_obj2: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 492        m21_obj1, m21_obj2 = op.get_m21_objs()
 493
 494        name1: str = ''
 495        name2: str = ''
 496        if name:
 497            name1 = name
 498            name2 = name
 499        else:
 500            if m21_obj1 is not None:
 501                name1 = m21_obj1.classes[0]
 502                if isinstance(op.obj1, AnnNote):
 503                    if op.obj1.is_in_chord:
 504                        assert isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 505                        name1 = m21_obj1.notes[0].classes[0]
 506            if m21_obj2 is not None:
 507                name2 = m21_obj2.classes[0]
 508                if isinstance(op.obj2, AnnNote):
 509                    if op.obj2.is_in_chord:
 510                        assert isinstance(m21_obj2, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 511                        name2 = m21_obj2.notes[0].classes[0]
 512
 513        if name == 'metadata':
 514            # change m21_obj1/m21_obj2 to score1.metadata and score2.metadata
 515            if m21_obj1 is not None:
 516                m21_obj1 = score1.metadata
 517            if m21_obj2 is not None:
 518                m21_obj2 = score2.metadata
 519
 520        readable_str_subname: str = ''
 521        changedStr: str = ''
 522        if sub_name:
 523            readable_str_subname = Visualization.READABLE_STR_NAMES.get(sub_name, sub_name)
 524            if sub_name == 'info':
 525                # only AnnExtra has infodict
 526                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnExtra)
 527                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnExtra)
 528                changedStr = Visualization._dict_change_str(op.obj1.infodict, op.obj2.infodict)
 529                name1 += f':{changedStr}'
 530                name2 += f':{changedStr}'
 531            elif sub_name == 'style':
 532                # every AnnObject has styledict
 533                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 534                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 535                changedStr = Visualization._dict_change_str(op.obj1.styledict, op.obj2.styledict)
 536                name1 += f':{changedStr}'
 537                name2 += f':{changedStr}'
 538            else:
 539                # other sub_names just go in the output
 540                name1 += f':{sub_name}'
 541                name2 += f':{sub_name}'
 542
 543        if m21_obj1 is not None:
 544            assert op.obj1 is not None
 545            note_idx: int = 0
 546            if op.indexes is not None:
 547                if isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 548                    if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 549                        note_idx = op.indexes
 550                    else:
 551                        note_idx = op.indexes[0]
 552                else:
 553                    # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 554                    # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 555                    # Don't crash by looking for notes, just use whatever the
 556                    # non-Chord object is.
 557                    pass
 558
 559            newLine: str = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj1, score1)} @@\n'
 560            oneOutput = newLine
 561            readable: str = op.obj1.readable_str(
 562                readable_str_subname, idx=note_idx, changedStr=changedStr
 563            )
 564            newLine = f'-({name1}) {readable}'
 565            oneOutput += newLine
 566
 567        if m21_obj2 is not None:
 568            assert op.obj2 is not None
 569            # do we need a location_of(2)?  Yes if no obj1, and yes if obj1 offset is different.
 570            if op.obj1 is None:
 571                # This is the first line of the output
 572                newLine = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj2, score2)} @@\n'
 573                oneOutput = newLine
 574            elif op.obj1.offset != op.obj2.offset:
 575                # not first line, and we need location_of(2)
 576                outputList.append(oneOutput)
 577                newLine = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj2, score2)} @@\n'
 578                oneOutput = newLine
 579            else:
 580                # not first line, but no location_of(2) needed; just an EOL
 581                oneOutput += '\n'
 582
 583            note_idx = 0
 584            if op.indexes is not None:
 585                if isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 586                    if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 587                        note_idx = op.indexes
 588                    else:
 589                        note_idx = op.indexes[1]
 590                else:
 591                    # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 592                    # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 593                    # Don't crash by looking for notes, just use whatever the
 594                    # non-Chord object is.
 595                    pass
 596
 597            readable = op.obj2.readable_str(
 598                readable_str_subname, idx=note_idx, changedStr=changedStr
 599            )
 600            newLine = f'+({name2}) {readable}'
 601            oneOutput += newLine
 602
 603        outputList.append(oneOutput)
 604        return outputList
 605
 606    @staticmethod
 607    def get_text_output(
 608        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 609        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 610        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
 611        score1Name: str | Path | None = None,
 612        score2Name: str | Path | None = None
 613    ) -> str:
 614        '''
 615        Generate text output from the differences described by an operations list
 616        (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
 617
 618        Args:
 619            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score that was compared
 620            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score that was compared
 621            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
 622                between the two scores
 623            score1Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the first score in the text output
 624            score2Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the second score in the text output
 625        '''
 626        output: str | None = Visualization._visualize_op_list(
 627            op_list,
 628            score1,
 629            score2,
 630            'text',
 631            score1Name,
 632            score2Name
 633        )
 634
 635        assert isinstance(output, str)
 636        return output
 637
 638    @staticmethod
 639    def _visualize_op_list(
 640        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
 641        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 642        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 643        vis_type: str,
 644        score1Name: str | Path | None = None,
 645        score2Name: str | Path | None = None,
 646    ) -> str | None:
 647        '''
 648        Generate text output from the differences described by an operations list
 649        (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
 650
 651        Args:
 652            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score that was compared
 653            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score that was compared
 654            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
 655                between the two scores
 656            score1Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the first score in the text output
 657            score2Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the second score in the text output
 658        '''
 659        vis_func: Visualization.VisFunctionType
 660
 661        output: str
 662        outputList: list[str] = []
 663
 664        if vis_type == 'text':
 665            vis_func = Visualization._text_diff
 666        elif vis_type == 'draw':
 667            vis_func = Visualization._draw_diffs
 668        else:

 671        for op in op_list:

1152
1153            if op.name == 'editexpression':
1154                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1155                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1156                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1157                    opname='changed', sub_name='expression', custom_text='changed expression')
1158                if text_diff is not None:
1159                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1160                continue
1161
1162            # articulations
1163            if op.name == 'insarticulation':
1164                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1165                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1166                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1167                    opname='inserted', sub_name='artic', custom_text='inserted articulation')
1168                if text_diff is not None:
1169                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1170                continue
1171
1172            if op.name == 'delarticulation':
1173                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1174                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1175                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1176                    opname='deleted', sub_name='artic', custom_text='deleted articulation')
1177                if text_diff is not None:
1178                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1179                continue
1180
1181            if op.name == 'editarticulation':
1182                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1183                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1184                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1185                    opname='changed', sub_name='artic', custom_text='changed articulation')
1186                if text_diff is not None:
1187                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1188                continue
1189
1190            # lyrics
1191            if op.name == 'lyricins':
1192                assert op.obj1 is None
1193                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1194                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1195                    opname='inserted', name='Lyric')
1196                if text_diff is not None:
1197                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1198                continue
1199
1200            if op.name == 'lyricdel':
1201                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1202                assert op.obj2 is None
1203                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1204                    opname='deleted', name='Lyric')
1205                if text_diff is not None:
1206                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1207                continue
1208
1209            if op.name == 'lyricedit':
1210                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1211                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1212                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1213                    opname='changed', name='Lyric', sub_name='rawtext',
1214                    custom_text='changed lyric')
1215                if text_diff is not None:
1216                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1217                continue
1218
1219            if op.name == 'lyricnumedit':
1220                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1221                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1222                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1223                    opname='changed', name='Lyric', sub_name='number',
1224                    custom_text='changed lyric verse num')
1225                if text_diff is not None:
1226                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1227                continue
1228
1229            if op.name == 'lyricidedit':
1230                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1231                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1232                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1233                    opname='changed', name='Lyric', sub_name='id',
1234                    custom_text='changed lyric verse id')
1235                if text_diff is not None:
1236                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1237                continue
1238
1239            if op.name == 'lyricoffsetedit':
1240                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1241                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1242                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1243                    opname='changed', name='Lyric', sub_name='offset')
1244                if text_diff is not None:
1245                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1246                continue
1247
1248            if op.name == 'lyricstyleedit':
1249                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1250                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1251                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1252                    opname='changed', name='Lyric', sub_name='style')
1253                if text_diff is not None:
1254                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1255                continue
1256
1257            # metadata
1258            if op.name == 'mditemins':
1259                assert op.obj1 is None
1260                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1261                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, name='metadata', opname='inserted')
1262                if text_diff is not None:
1263                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1264                continue
1265
1266            if op.name == 'mditemdel':
1267                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1268                assert op.obj2 is None
1269                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, name='metadata', opname='deleted')
1270                if text_diff is not None:
1271                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1272                continue
1273
1274            if op.name == 'mditemvalueedit':
1275                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
1276                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
1277                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
1278                    name='metadata', opname='changed', sub_name='value')
1279                if text_diff is not None:
1280                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
1281                continue
1282
1283            print(
1284                f'Annotation type {op.name} not yet supported for visualization',
1285                file=sys.stderr
1286            )
1287
1288        if vis_type == 'draw':
1289            return None
1290
1291        # The rest of this is all about vis_type == 'text' and the outputList.
1292
1293        # Sort by measure number (int), then measure number suffix (str), then part
1294        # number, and then beat (as parsed from '@@ measure 3b, staff 2, beat 1.5 @@')
1295        # The goal is for all measure 0's to be printed first (with measure 0's staff 0
1296        # first), with the contents of each staff of each measure coming out in beat order.
1297        LOC_PATTERN: str = (
1298            r'\@\@ measure (\d+)(\w*), staff (\d+), beat (\d+|\d+[./]\d+|\d+ \d+/\d+) \@\@'
1299        )
1300        def measNum(s: str) -> int:
1301            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1302            if not m:
1303                return -1
1304            measNumStr: str = m.group(1)
1305            measNum: int = -1
1306            try:
1307                measNum = int(measNumStr)
1308            except Exception:
1309                pass
1310            return measNum
1311
1312        def measSuf(s: str) -> str:
1313            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1314            if not m:
1315                return ''
1316            measSuf: str = m.group(2)
1317            return measSuf
1318
1319        def staffNum(s: str) -> int:
1320            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1321            if not m:
1322                return -1
1323            staffNumStr: str = m.group(3)
1324            staffNum: int = -1
1325            try:
1326                staffNum = int(staffNumStr)
1327            except Exception:
1328                pass
1329            return staffNum
1330
1331        def beat(s: str) -> OffsetQL:
1332            # can be of the form 'j n/m' (mixed), 'n/m' (Fraction), or 'n.m' (float)
1333            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1334            if not m:
1335                return 0.
1336            beatStr: str = m.group(4)
1337            beats: OffsetQL = 0.
1338            beatsFrac: Fraction = Fraction(0, 1)
1339            beatsFloat: float = 0.
1340            try:
1341                if ' ' in beatStr and '/' in beatStr:
1342                    # mixed fraction 'j n/m'
1343                    nums: list[str] = beatStr.split(' ')
1344                    wholeNum: int = int(nums[0])
1345                    frac: Fraction = Fraction(nums[1])
1346                    beats = opFrac(wholeNum + frac)
1347                elif '/' in beatStr:
1348                    # fraction
1349                    beatsFrac = Fraction(beatStr)
1350                    beats = opFrac(beatsFrac)
1351                else:
1352                    beatsFloat = float(beatStr)
1353                    beats = opFrac(beatsFloat)
1354            except Exception:
1355                pass
1356            return beats
1357
1358        outputList.sort(key=lambda s: (measNum(s), measSuf(s), staffNum(s), beat(s)))
1359
1360        if op_list:
1361            # filenames only show up at the start of text output if there are any diffs
1362            if score1Name:
1363                outputList.insert(0, f'--- {score1Name}')
1364                outputList.insert(1, f'+++ {score2Name}')
1365            else:
1366                outputList.insert(0, '--- score1')
1367                outputList.insert(1, '+++ score2')
1368
1369        output = '\n'.join(outputList)
1370        return output
1371
1372    @staticmethod
1373    def get_omr_ned_output(
1374        omr_ed: int,
1375        annotated_predicted_score: AnnScore,
1376        annotated_ground_truth_score: AnnScore,
1377    ) -> dict[str, str]:
1378        num_syms_in_ground_truth: int = annotated_ground_truth_score.notation_size()
1379        num_syms_in_predicted: int = annotated_predicted_score.notation_size()
1380        omr_ned: float = Visualization.get_omr_ned(
1381            omr_ed, num_syms_in_predicted, num_syms_in_ground_truth
1382        )
1383        num_syms_in_both: int = num_syms_in_ground_truth + num_syms_in_predicted
1384        output: dict[str, str] = {
1385            'OMR-ED': f'{omr_ed}',
1386            'numSymbolsInPredicted': f'{num_syms_in_predicted}',
1387            'numSymbolsInGroundTruth': f'{num_syms_in_ground_truth}',
1388            'numSymbolsInBoth': f'{num_syms_in_both}',
1389            'OMR-NED': f'{omr_ned}',
1390        }
1391        return output
1392
1393    @staticmethod
1394    def get_omr_ned(
1395        omr_ed: int,
1396        num_syms_in_predicted: int,
1397        num_syms_in_ground_truth: int,
1398    ) -> float:
1399        num_syms_in_both: int = num_syms_in_ground_truth + num_syms_in_predicted
1400
1401        # Instead of divide by zero, return omr_ned == 0.0 (because both scores being
1402        # empty means they are exactly the same)
1403        omr_ned: float = 0.0
1404        if num_syms_in_both != 0:
1405            omr_ned = float(omr_ed) / float(num_syms_in_both)
1406        return omr_ned
1407
1408    @staticmethod
1409    def get_edit_distances_dict(
1410        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
1411        num_syntax_errors_fixed: int,
1412        detail: DetailLevel | int
1413    ) -> dict[str, int]:
1414        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1415
1416        edit_distances_dict: dict[str, int] = {}
1417        for op in op_list:
1418            edit_name: str = op.name
1419            if edit_name.startswith('extra'):
1420                extra: AnnObject | None = op.obj1 or op.obj2
1421                if extra is not None:
1422                    assert isinstance(extra, AnnExtra)
1423                    if extra.kind:
1424                        edit_name = re.sub('extra', extra.kind, edit_name)
1425
1426            if edit_name not in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1427                edit_name = 'directionins'  # default to direction
1428            name: str = Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME[edit_name]
1429
1430            omr_ed: int = op.edit_distance
1431            if name not in edit_distances_dict:
1432                edit_distances_dict[name] = omr_ed
1433            else:
1434                edit_distances_dict[name] = edit_distances_dict[name] + omr_ed
1435
1436        edit_distances_dict['bad kern syntax OMR-ED'] = num_syntax_errors_fixed
1437
1438        return edit_distances_dict
1439
1440    @staticmethod
1441    def create_header_names_once(detail: DetailLevel | int):
1442        if Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1443            return
1444
1445        if DetailLevel.includesVoicing(detail):
1446            Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME.update(
1447                Visualization._VOICING_HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME_EXTRAS
1448            )
1449
1450        ordered_names: list[str] = []
1451        for en in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1452            hn: str = Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME[en]
1453            if hn in ordered_names:
1454                continue
1455            ordered_names.append(hn)
1456            ordered_names.append(re.sub('OMR-ED', '% contribution to OMR-NED', hn))
1457
1458        Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES = ordered_names
1459

1738        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1739

1741        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1742            header += ', '  # even at start of header (empty column, for 'Totals:' at the bottom)

1744        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1745            header += ', '

1753    @staticmethod
1754    def get_output_csv_trailer(
1755        metrics_list: list[EvaluationMetrics],
1756        detail: DetailLevel | int
1757    ) -> str:
1758        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1759
1760        # Compute all the totals
1761        total_gt_numsyms: int = 0
1762        total_pred_numsyms: int = 0
1763        total_omr_edit_distance: int = 0
1764        total_edit_distances_dict: dict[str, int] = {}
1765
1766        for metrics in metrics_list:
1767            total_gt_numsyms += metrics.gt_numsyms
1768            total_pred_numsyms += metrics.pred_numsyms
1769            total_omr_edit_distance += metrics.omr_edit_distance
1770            for name in metrics.edit_distances_dict:
1771                if name not in total_edit_distances_dict:
1772                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] = metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1773                else:
1774                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] += metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1775
1776        total_numsyms: int = total_gt_numsyms + total_pred_numsyms
1777
1778        overall_omr_ned: float = Visualization.get_omr_ned(
1779            total_omr_edit_distance, total_pred_numsyms, total_gt_numsyms
1780        )
1781
1782        totals_line: str = 'Total:'  # the only thing in first column
1783
1784        # first the pre-edits fields
1785        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1786            totals_line += ', '
1787            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1788                pass  # leave empty
1789            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1790                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1791            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1792                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1793            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1794                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1795            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1796                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1797            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1798                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1799
1800        # then the edit fields
1801        previous_column_edit_distance: int = 0
1802        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1803            totals_line += ', '
1804            if name.endswith('OMR-ED'):
1805                if name in total_edit_distances_dict:
1806                    previous_column_edit_distance = total_edit_distances_dict[name]
1807                    totals_line += f'{total_edit_distances_dict[name]}'
1808                else:
1809                    previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1810                    totals_line += '0'
1811            elif name.endswith('% contribution to OMR-NED'):
1812                if previous_column_edit_distance:
1813                    contrib: float = (
1814                        float(previous_column_edit_distance * 100)
1815                        / float(total_omr_edit_distance)
1816                    )
1817                    totals_line += f'{contrib}'
1818                else:
1819                    totals_line += '0.'
1820                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1821            else:
1822                # how did we get here?
1823                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1824
1825
1826        # then the post-edits fields
1827        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1828            totals_line += ', '
1829            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1830                pass  # leave empty
1831            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1832                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1833            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1834                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1835            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1836                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1837            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1838                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1839            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1840                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1841
1842        repeated_header_line: str = Visualization.get_output_csv_header(detail)
1843
1844        trailer_line: str = totals_line + '\n' + repeated_header_line
1845        return trailer_line

1847    @staticmethod
1848    def get_output_csv_line(
1849        metrics: EvaluationMetrics,
1850        detail: DetailLevel | int
1851    ) -> str:
1852        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1853
1854        # 888 could validate metrics.omr_edit_distance here (make sure it is the sum of
1855        # 888 everything in metrics.edit_distances_dict)
1856        total_numsyms: int = metrics.pred_numsyms + metrics.gt_numsyms
1857
1858        line: str = ''
1859
1860        # first the pre-edits fields
1861        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1862            line += ', '  # even at start of line (empty column, for 'Totals:' at the bottom)
1863            if name == 'gtpath':
1864                line += str(metrics.gt_path)
1865            elif name == 'predpath':
1866                line += str(metrics.pred_path)
1867            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1868                line += f'{metrics.gt_numsyms}'
1869            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1870                line += f'{metrics.pred_numsyms}'
1871            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1872                line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1873            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1874                line += f'{metrics.omr_edit_distance}'
1875            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1876                line += f'{metrics.omr_ned}'
1877
1878        # then the edit fields
1879        previous_column_edit_distance: int = 0
1880        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1881            line += ', '
1882            if name.endswith('OMR-ED'):
1883                if name in metrics.edit_distances_dict:
1884                    previous_column_edit_distance = metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1885                    line += f'{metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]}'
1886                else:
1887                    line += '0'
1888            elif name.endswith('% contribution to OMR-NED'):
1889                if previous_column_edit_distance:
1890                    contrib: float = (
1891                        float(previous_column_edit_distance * 100)
1892                        / float(metrics.omr_edit_distance)
1893                    )
1894                    line += (
1895                        f'{contrib}'
1896                    )
1897                else:
1898                    line += '0.'
1899                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1900            else:
1901                # how did we get here?
1902                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1903
1904        # then the post-edits fields
1905        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1906            line += ', '
1907            if name == 'gtpath':
1908                line += str(metrics.gt_path)
1909            elif name == 'predpath':
1910                line += str(metrics.pred_path)
1911            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1912                line += f'{metrics.gt_numsyms}'
1913            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1914                line += f'{metrics.pred_numsyms}'
1915            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1916                line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1917            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1918                line += f'{metrics.omr_edit_distance}'
1919            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1920                line += f'{metrics.omr_ned}'
1921
1922        return line
class Visualization: 
  33class Visualization:

  35    INSERTED_COLOR = 'red'

  37    `INSERTED_COLOR` can be set to customize the rendered score markup that `mark_diffs` does.

  49        'inserted': INSERTED_COLOR,

  69    @staticmethod
  70    def mark_diffs(
  71        score1: m21.stream.Score,
  72        score2: m21.stream.Score,
  73        op_list: list[DiffOperation]
  74    ) -> None:
  75        '''
  76        Mark up two music21 scores with the differences described by an operations
  77        list (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
  78
  79        Args:
  80            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score to mark up
  81            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score to mark up
  82            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
  83                between the two scores
  84        '''
  85        Visualization._visualize_op_list(
  86            op_list,
  87            score1,
  88            score2,
  89            'draw'
  90        )
