  92    @staticmethod
  93    def _draw_diffs(
  94        op: DiffOperation,
  95        score1: m21.stream.Score,
  96        score2: m21.stream.Score,
  97        # the next set of params are only for drawing in the score (used here)
  98        opname: str = '',  # must be 'inserted', 'deleted', 'changed'
  99        custom_text: str = '',  # replaces opname + name + sub_name
 100        # (e.g. 'changed grace note' instead of 'changed' + 'note' + 'grace')
 101        color_accidental_too: bool = False,
 102        # the next set of params are for both types of visualization
 103        name: str = '',  # name of object
 104        sub_name: str = '',  # e.g. 'content' or 'sym'
 105    ) -> list[str]:
 106        if name == 'metadata':
 107            # someday we will draw some of the metadata changes
 108            return []
 109
 110        m21_obj1: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 111        m21_obj2: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 112        m21_obj1, m21_obj2 = op.get_m21_objs()
 113
 114        note_idx1: int | None = None
 115        note_idx2: int | None = None
 116        if op.indexes is not None:
 117            # we have pitch indexes within an AnnNote (which is a Chord)
 118            if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 119                if op.obj1 is not None and op.obj2 is None:
 120                    note_idx1 = op.indexes
 121                elif op.obj1 is None and op.obj2 is not None:
 122                    note_idx2 = op.indexes
 123                else:
 124                    raise ValueError(
 125                        'invalid call to _draw_diffs: one note_idx, but two (or zero) chords'
 126                    )
 127            else:
 128                assert isinstance(op.indexes, tuple)
 129                assert len(op.indexes) == 2
 130                assert isinstance(op.indexes[0], int)
 131                assert isinstance(op.indexes[1], int)
 132                note_idx1 = op.indexes[0]
 133                note_idx2 = op.indexes[1]
 134        else:
 135            # This is an AnnNote that is a Note within a Chord.
 136            if isinstance(op.obj1, AnnNote) and op.obj1.is_in_chord:
 137                if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 138                    assert isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 139                note_idx1 = op.obj1.note_idx_in_chord
 140                if not name:
 141                    if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 142                        assert isinstance(note_idx1, int)
 143                    name = m21_obj1.notes[note_idx1].classes[0]
 144            if isinstance(op.obj2, AnnNote) and op.obj2.is_in_chord:
 145                if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 146                    assert isinstance(m21_obj2, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 147                note_idx2 = op.obj2.note_idx_in_chord
 148                if not name:
 149                    if t.TYPE_CHECKING:
 150                        assert isinstance(note_idx2, int)
 151                    name = m21_obj2.notes[note_idx2].classes[0]
 152
 153        if sub_name in ('symbolic', 'content', 'info'):
 154            # e.g. "changed Barline symbolic" should actually be "changed Barline"
 155            # e.g. "changed TextExpression content" should actually be "changed TextExpression"
 156            # e.g. "changed KeySignature info" should actually be "changed KeySignature"
 157            sub_name = ''
 158        elif sub_name == 'style':
 159            styledict1: dict[str, str] = {}
 160            styledict2: dict[str, str] = {}
 161            if op.obj1 is not None:
 162                styledict1 = op.obj1.styledict
 163            if op.obj2 is not None:
 164                styledict2 = op.obj2.styledict
 165            change_str: str = Visualization._dict_change_str(styledict1, styledict2)
 166            if change_str:
 167                sub_name = change_str
 168
 169        if m21_obj1 is not None:
 170            obj1_text: str = custom_text
 171            if not obj1_text:
 172                # opname + name + sub_name
 173                obj1_text = name
 174                if not obj1_text:
 175                    obj1_text = m21_obj1.classes[0]
 176                if sub_name:
 177                    obj1_text += ' ' + sub_name
 178                obj1_text = opname + ' ' + obj1_text
 179            Visualization._draw_diff(
 180                m21_obj1,
 181                text=obj1_text,
 182                color=Visualization.COLOR_FOR_OPNAME[opname],
 183                note_idx=note_idx1,
 184                color_accidental_too=color_accidental_too
 185            )
 186
 187        if m21_obj2 is not None:
 188            obj2_text: str = custom_text
 189            if not obj2_text:
 190                # opname + name + sub_name
 191                obj2_text = name
 192                if not obj2_text:
 193                    obj2_text = m21_obj2.classes[0]
 194                if sub_name:
 195                    obj2_text += ' ' + sub_name
 196                obj2_text = opname + ' ' + obj2_text
 197            Visualization._draw_diff(
 198                m21_obj2,
 199                text=obj2_text,
 200                color=Visualization.COLOR_FOR_OPNAME[opname],
 201                note_idx=note_idx2,
 202                color_accidental_too=color_accidental_too
 203            )
 204
 205        return []  # ignored by callers
 206
 207    @staticmethod
 208    def _draw_diff(
 209        m21_obj: m21.base.Music21Object,
 210        text: str,
 211        color: str,
 212        note_idx: int | None = None,
 213        color_accidental_too: bool = False
 214    ):
 215        # Create (and color) text expression, and insert it as requested
 216        textExp = m21.expressions.TextExpression(text)
 217        textExp.style.color = color
 218
 219        insert_in_stream: m21.stream.Stream | None = None
 220        insert_at_offset: OffsetQL | None = None
 221        if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Stream):
 222            if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Part):
 223                # insert at beginning of the first Measure of Part
 224                insert_in_stream = m21_obj[m21.stream.Measure].first()
 225                insert_at_offset = 0.
 226            else:
 227                # insert at beginning of the stream
 228                insert_in_stream = m21_obj
 229                insert_at_offset = 0.
 230        elif isinstance(m21_obj, m21.spanner.Spanner):
 231            spannerFirst: m21.base.Music21Object = m21_obj.getFirst()
 232            if isinstance(spannerFirst, m21.stream.Part):
 233                # spannerFirst is a Part, put the textExp at beginning
 234                # of the first Measure in the Part
 235                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst[m21.stream.Measure].first()
 236                insert_at_offset = 0.
 237            elif isinstance(spannerFirst, m21.stream.Stream):
 238                # spannerFirst is a Stream, put the textExp at beginning
 239                # of the Stream
 240                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst
 241                insert_at_offset = 0.
 242            else:
 243                # spannerFirst is not a Stream, put the textExp right next to it.
 244                insert_in_stream = spannerFirst.activeSite
 245                insert_at_offset = spannerFirst.offset
 246        else:
 247            # neither Stream nor Spanner, put the textExp right next to it.
 248            insert_in_stream = m21_obj.activeSite
 249            insert_at_offset = m21_obj.offset
 250
 251        if insert_in_stream is not None and insert_at_offset is not None:
 252            insert_in_stream.insert(insert_at_offset, textExp)
 253        else:
 254            # should never happen, but might if the code above is modified.
 255            raise ValueError('stream or offset of descriptive text is unknown.')
 256
 257        # Now color the m21_obj with the requested color
 258        if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.stream.Stream):
 259            # m21_obj is a Score or Part or Measure or Voice...
 260            # Color every note and rest in that stream, recursively.
 261            # Don't bother with accidentals (we don't bother with
 262            # extras either, for that matter).
 263            for el in m21_obj.recurse().notesAndRests:
 264                el.style.color = color
 265        elif note_idx is not None:
 266            if isinstance(m21_obj, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 267                specified_note: m21.note.GeneralNote = m21_obj.notes[note_idx]
 268                specified_note.style.color = color
 269                if color_accidental_too and hasattr(specified_note, 'pitch'):
 270                    if specified_note.pitch.accidental:
 271                        specified_note.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 272            else:
 273                # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 274                # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 275                # Don't crash by looking for notes, just color whatever the
 276                # non-Chord object is.
 277                m21_obj.style.color = color
 278                if color_accidental_too and hasattr(m21_obj, 'pitch'):
 279                    if m21_obj.pitch.accidental:
 280                        m21_obj.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 281        else:
 282            m21_obj.style.color = color
 283            if color_accidental_too and hasattr(m21_obj, 'pitch'):
 284                if m21_obj.pitch.accidental:
 285                    m21_obj.pitch.accidental.style.color = color
 286
 287    @staticmethod
 288    def _dict_change_str(dict1: dict[str, str], dict2: dict[str, str]) -> str:
 289        # returns a comma-delimited list of differing keys (either missing in
 290        # one of the dictionaries, or existing in both but with different values).
 291        change_str: str = ''
 292        for k1, v1 in dict1.items():
 293            if k1 not in dict2 or dict2[k1] != v1:
 294                if change_str:
 295                    change_str += ','
 296                change_str += k1
 297        # one last thing: check for keys in dict2 that aren't in dict1
 298        for k2 in dict2:
 299            if k2 not in dict1:
 300                if change_str:
 301                    change_str += ','
 302                change_str += k2
 303        return change_str
 304
 305    @staticmethod
 306    def show_diffs(
 307        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 308        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 309        out_path1: str | Path | None = None,
 310        out_path2: str | Path | None = None
 311    ) -> None:
 312        '''
 313        Render two (presumably marked-up) music21 scores.  If both out_path1 and
 314        out_path2 are not None, save the rendered PDFs at those two locations,
 315        otherwise just display them using the default PDF viewer on the system.
 316
 317        Args:
 318            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score to render
 319            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score to render
 320            out_path1 (str, Path): Where to save the first marked-up rendered score PDF.
 321                If out_path1 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
 322                (default is None)
 323            out_path2 (str, Path): Where to save the second marked-up rendered score PDF.
 324                If out_path2 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
 325                (default is None)
 326        '''
 327        # display the two (presumably annotated) scores
 328
 329        # avoid some crashes during write()/show() operations
 330        from converter21 import M21Utilities
 331        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score1, inPlace=True)
 332        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score2, inPlace=True)
 333
 334        originalComposer1: str | None = None
 335        originalComposer2: str | None = None
 336
 337        if score1.metadata is None:
 338            score1.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
 339        if score2.metadata is None:
 340            score2.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
 341
 342        originalComposer1 = score1.metadata.composer
 343        if originalComposer1 is None:
 344            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1'
 345        else:
 346            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1          ' + originalComposer1
 347
 348        originalComposer2 = score2.metadata.composer
 349        if originalComposer2 is None:
 350            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2'
 351        else:
 352            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2          ' + originalComposer2
 353
 354        # save files if requested
 355        if (out_path1 is not None) and (out_path2 is not None):
 356            score1.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path1)
 357            score2.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path2)
 358            print(f'Annotated scores saved in {out_path1} and {out_path2}.', file=sys.stderr)
 359        else:
 360            # just display the scores
 361            score1.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)
 362            score2.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)
 363
 364    @staticmethod
 365    def _location_of(m21obj: m21.base.Music21Object, score: m21.stream.Score) -> str:
 366        output: str
 367        meas: m21.stream.Stream | None
 368        part: m21.stream.Stream | None
 369        staffNum: int
 370        fractionalBeats: OffsetQL
 371
 372        if isinstance(m21obj, (m21.metadata.Metadata, m21.layout.StaffGroup)):
 373            # These are not in the timeline.  Put them first (there may be a
 374            # a measure 0/staff 0, but the first beat of that measure is beat 1).
 375            output = 'measure 0, staff 0, beat 0.0'
 376            return output
 377
 378        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.spanner.RepeatBracket):
 379            # spans measures, location is start of first measure in RepeatBracket
 380            meas = m21obj.getFirst()
 381            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 382                return ''
 383            part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 384            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 385                return ''
 386            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 387            staffNum += 1  # staff number is 1-based
 388            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 389            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 390            fractionalBeats = 1.
 391            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 392            return output
 393
 394        # part
 395        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Part):
 396            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(m21obj, score)
 397            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 398            output = 'measure 0, '
 399            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 400            fractionalBeats = 1.
 401            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 402            return output
 403
 404        # measure
 405        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Measure):
 406            part = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 407            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 408                return ''
 409            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 410            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 411            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(m21obj, part)}, '
 412            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 413            fractionalBeats = 1.
 414            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 415            return output
 416
 417        # voice
 418        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.stream.Voice):
 419            meas = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 420            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 421                return ''
 422            part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 423            if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 424                return ''
 425            staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 426            staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 427            voiceStartOffset: OffsetQL = m21obj.getOffsetInHierarchy(meas)
 428            output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 429            output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 430            ts: m21.meter.TimeSignature | None = m21obj.getContextByClass(m21.meter.TimeSignature)
 431            if ts is None:
 432                ts = m21.meter.TimeSignature()  # 4/4
 433            fractionalBeats = M21Utils.get_beats(voiceStartOffset, ts)
 434            output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 435            return output
 436
 437        # spanner
 438        if isinstance(m21obj, m21.spanner.Spanner):
 439            first: m21.base.Music21Object | None = m21obj.getFirst()
 440            if first is None:
 441                return ''
 442            m21obj = first
 443            # fall through to handle normal non-stream/non-spanner m21obj
 444
 445        # normal object (not stream, not spanner)
 446        container: m21.stream.Stream | None = score.containerInHierarchy(m21obj)
 447        if isinstance(container, m21.stream.Measure):
 448            meas = container
 449        elif isinstance(container, m21.stream.Voice):
 450            meas = score.containerInHierarchy(container)
 451            if not isinstance(meas, m21.stream.Measure):
 452                return ''
 453        else:
 454            return ''
 455
 456        part = score.containerInHierarchy(meas)
 457        if not isinstance(part, m21.stream.Part):
 458            return ''
 459        staffNum = M21Utils.get_part_index(part, score)
 460        staffNum += 1  # staffNum is 1-based
 461        startOffset: OffsetQL = m21obj.getOffsetInHierarchy(meas)
 462        output = f'measure {M21Utils.get_measure_number_with_suffix(meas, part)}, '
 463        output += f'staff {staffNum}, '
 464        ts = m21obj.getContextByClass(m21.meter.TimeSignature)
 465        if ts is None:
 466            ts = m21.meter.TimeSignature()  # 4/4
 467        fractionalBeats = M21Utils.get_beats(startOffset, ts)
 468        output += f'beat {M21Utils.ql_to_string(fractionalBeats)}'
 469        return output
 470
 471    READABLE_STR_NAMES: dict[str, str] = {
 472        'dur': 'duration'
 473    }
 474
 475    @staticmethod
 476    def _text_diff(
 477        op: DiffOperation,
 478        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 479        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 480        # the next set of params are only for drawing in the score (used here)
 481        opname: str = '',  # must be 'inserted', 'deleted', 'changed'
 482        custom_text: str = '',
 483        color_accidental_too: bool = False,
 484        # the next set of params are only for diff-like text output (unused here)
 485        name: str = '',  # name of object
 486        sub_name: str = '',  # e.g. 'content' or 'sym'
 487    ) -> list[str]:
 488        outputList: list[str] = []
 489        oneOutput: str  # one string, multiple lines (with \n at end of all but last line)
 490
 491        m21_obj1: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 492        m21_obj2: m21.base.Music21Object | None
 493        m21_obj1, m21_obj2 = op.get_m21_objs()
 494
 495        name1: str = ''
 496        name2: str = ''
 497        if name:
 498            name1 = name
 499            name2 = name
 500        else:
 501            if m21_obj1 is not None:
 502                name1 = m21_obj1.classes[0]
 503                if isinstance(op.obj1, AnnNote):
 504                    if op.obj1.is_in_chord:
 505                        assert isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 506                        name1 = m21_obj1.notes[0].classes[0]
 507            if m21_obj2 is not None:
 508                name2 = m21_obj2.classes[0]
 509                if isinstance(op.obj2, AnnNote):
 510                    if op.obj2.is_in_chord:
 511                        assert isinstance(m21_obj2, m21.chord.ChordBase)
 512                        name2 = m21_obj2.notes[0].classes[0]
 513
 514        if name == 'metadata':
 515            # change m21_obj1/m21_obj2 to score1.metadata and score2.metadata
 516            if m21_obj1 is not None:
 517                m21_obj1 = score1.metadata
 518            if m21_obj2 is not None:
 519                m21_obj2 = score2.metadata
 520
 521        readable_str_subname: str = ''
 522        changedStr: str = ''
 523        if sub_name:
 524            readable_str_subname = Visualization.READABLE_STR_NAMES.get(sub_name, sub_name)
 525            if sub_name == 'info':
 526                # only AnnExtra has infodict
 527                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnExtra)
 528                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnExtra)
 529                changedStr = Visualization._dict_change_str(op.obj1.infodict, op.obj2.infodict)
 530                name1 += f':{changedStr}'
 531                name2 += f':{changedStr}'
 532            elif sub_name == 'style':
 533                # every AnnObject has styledict
 534                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 535                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 536                changedStr = Visualization._dict_change_str(op.obj1.styledict, op.obj2.styledict)
 537                name1 += f':{changedStr}'
 538                name2 += f':{changedStr}'
 539            else:
 540                # other sub_names just go in the output
 541                name1 += f':{sub_name}'
 542                name2 += f':{sub_name}'
 543
 544        if m21_obj1 is not None:
 545            assert op.obj1 is not None
 546            note_idx: int = 0
 547            if op.indexes is not None:
 548                if isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 549                    if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 550                        note_idx = op.indexes
 551                    else:
 552                        note_idx = op.indexes[0]
 553                else:
 554                    # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 555                    # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 556                    # Don't crash by looking for notes, just use whatever the
 557                    # non-Chord object is.
 558                    pass
 559
 560            newLine: str = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj1, score1)} @@\n'
 561            oneOutput = newLine
 562            readable: str = op.obj1.readable_str(
 563                readable_str_subname, idx=note_idx, changedStr=changedStr
 564            )
 565            newLine = f'-({name1}) {readable}'
 566            oneOutput += newLine
 567
 568        if m21_obj2 is not None:
 569            assert op.obj2 is not None
 570            # do we need a location_of(2)?  Yes if no obj1, and yes if obj1 offset is different.
 571            if op.obj1 is None:
 572                # This is the first line of the output
 573                newLine = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj2, score2)} @@\n'
 574                oneOutput = newLine
 575            elif op.obj1.offset != op.obj2.offset:
 576                # not first line, and we need location_of(2)
 577                outputList.append(oneOutput)
 578                newLine = f'@@ {Visualization._location_of(m21_obj2, score2)} @@\n'
 579                oneOutput = newLine
 580            else:
 581                # not first line, but no location_of(2) needed; just an EOL
 582                oneOutput += '\n'
 583
 584            note_idx = 0
 585            if op.indexes is not None:
 586                if isinstance(m21_obj1, m21.chord.ChordBase):
 587                    if isinstance(op.indexes, int):
 588                        note_idx = op.indexes
 589                    else:
 590                        note_idx = op.indexes[1]
 591                else:
 592                    # Can happen if imported xml has repeated xml:id values,
 593                    # so getElementById returns an unexpected non-Chord.
 594                    # Don't crash by looking for notes, just use whatever the
 595                    # non-Chord object is.
 596                    pass
 597
 598            readable = op.obj2.readable_str(
 599                readable_str_subname, idx=note_idx, changedStr=changedStr
 600            )
 601            newLine = f'+({name2}) {readable}'
 602            oneOutput += newLine
 603
 604        outputList.append(oneOutput)
 605        return outputList
 606
 607    @staticmethod
 608    def get_text_output(
 609        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 610        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 611        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
 612        score1Name: str | Path | None = None,
 613        score2Name: str | Path | None = None
 614    ) -> str:
 615        '''
 616        Generate text output from the differences described by an operations list
 617        (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
 618
 619        Args:
 620            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score that was compared
 621            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score that was compared
 622            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
 623                between the two scores
 624            score1Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the first score in the text output
 625            score2Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the second score in the text output
 626        '''
 627        output: str | None = Visualization._visualize_op_list(
 628            op_list,
 629            score1,
 630            score2,
 631            'text',
 632            score1Name,
 633            score2Name
 634        )
 635
 636        assert isinstance(output, str)
 637        return output
 638
 639    @staticmethod
 640    def _visualize_op_list(
 641        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
 642        score1: m21.stream.Score,
 643        score2: m21.stream.Score,
 644        vis_type: str,
 645        score1Name: str | Path | None = None,
 646        score2Name: str | Path | None = None,
 647    ) -> str | None:
 648        '''
 649        Generate text output from the differences described by an operations list
 650        (e.g. a list returned from `musicdiff.Comparison.annotated_scores_diff`).
 651
 652        Args:
 653            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score that was compared
 654            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score that was compared
 655            op_list (list[DiffOperation]): The operations list that describes the difference
 656                between the two scores
 657            score1Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the first score in the text output
 658            score2Name (str | Path | None): The name to use for the second score in the text output
 659        '''
 660        vis_func: Visualization.VisFunctionType
 661
 662        output: str
 663        outputList: list[str] = []
 664
 665        if vis_type == 'text':
 666            vis_func = Visualization._text_diff
 667        elif vis_type == 'draw':
 668            vis_func = Visualization._draw_diffs
 669        else:
 670            raise ValueError(f"invalid vis_type: {vis_type}. Must be 'text' or 'draw'.")
 671
 672        for op in op_list:
 673            text_diff: list[str] | None
 674            # part
 675            if op.name == 'inspart':
 676                assert op.obj1 is None
 677                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 678                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted', name='part')
 679                if text_diff is not None:
 680                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 681                continue
 682
 683            if op.name == 'delpart':
 684                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 685                assert op.obj2 is None
 686                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted', name='part')
 687                if text_diff is not None:
 688                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 689                continue
 690
 691            # bar
 692            if op.name == 'insbar':
 693                assert op.obj1 is None
 694                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 695                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted', name='measure')
 696                if text_diff is not None:
 697                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 698                continue
 699
 700            if op.name == 'delbar':
 701                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 702                assert op.obj2 is None
 703                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted', name='measure')
 704                if text_diff is not None:
 705                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 706                continue
 707
 708            # voices
 709            if op.name == 'voiceins':
 710                assert op.obj1 is None
 711                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 712                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted', name='voice')
 713                if text_diff is not None:
 714                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 715                continue
 716
 717            if op.name == 'voicedel':
 718                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 719                assert op.obj2 is None
 720                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted', name='voice')
 721                if text_diff is not None:
 722                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 723                continue
 724
 725            # extra
 726            if op.name == 'extrains':
 727                assert op.obj1 is None
 728                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 729                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted')
 730                if text_diff is not None:
 731                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 732                continue
 733
 734            if op.name == 'extradel':
 735                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 736                assert op.obj2 is None
 737                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted')
 738                if text_diff is not None:
 739                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 740                continue
 741
 742            if op.name == 'extracontentedit':
 743                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 744                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 745                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='content')
 746                if text_diff is not None:
 747                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 748                continue
 749
 750            if op.name == 'extrasymboledit':
 751                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 752                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 753                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='symbolic')
 754                if text_diff is not None:
 755                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 756                continue
 757
 758            if op.name == 'extrainfoedit':
 759                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 760                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 761                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='info')
 762                if text_diff is not None:
 763                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 764                continue
 765
 766            if op.name == 'extraoffsetedit':  # pragma: no cover
 767                # cannot happen because we don't compare extras unless they are
 768                # at the same offset
 769                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 770                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 771                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='offset')
 772                if text_diff is not None:
 773                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 774                continue
 775
 776            if op.name == 'extradurationedit':
 777                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 778                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 779                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='dur')
 780                if text_diff is not None:
 781                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 782                continue
 783
 784            if op.name == 'extrastyleedit':
 785                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 786                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 787                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='style')
 788                if text_diff is not None:
 789                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 790                continue
 791
 792            # staff groups
 793            if op.name == 'staffgrpins':
 794                assert op.obj1 is None
 795                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 796                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted', name='StaffGroup')
 797                if text_diff is not None:
 798                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 799                continue
 800
 801            if op.name == 'staffgrpdel':
 802                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 803                assert op.obj2 is None
 804                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted', name='StaffGroup')
 805                if text_diff is not None:
 806                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 807                continue
 808
 809            if op.name == 'staffgrpnameedit':
 810                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 811                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 812                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
 813                    opname='changed', name='StaffGroup', sub_name='name')
 814                if text_diff is not None:
 815                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 816                continue
 817
 818            if op.name == 'staffgrpabbreviationedit':
 819                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 820                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 821                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
 822                    opname='changed', name='StaffGroup', sub_name='abbr')
 823                if text_diff is not None:
 824                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 825                continue
 826
 827            if op.name == 'staffgrpsymboledit':
 828                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 829                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 830                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
 831                    opname='changed', name='StaffGroup', sub_name='sym')
 832                if text_diff is not None:
 833                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 834                continue
 835
 836            if op.name == 'staffgrpbartogetheredit':
 837                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 838                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 839                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
 840                    opname='changed', name='StaffGroup', sub_name='barline')
 841                if text_diff is not None:
 842                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 843                continue
 844
 845            if op.name == 'staffgrppartindicesedit':
 846                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 847                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 848                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2,
 849                    opname='changed', name='StaffGroup', sub_name='parts')
 850                if text_diff is not None:
 851                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 852                continue
 853
 854            # note
 855            if op.name == 'noteins':
 856                assert op.obj1 is None
 857                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 858                assert op.indexes is None or isinstance(op.indexes, int)
 859                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='inserted')
 860                if text_diff is not None:
 861                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 862                continue
 863
 864            if op.name == 'notedel':
 865                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 866                assert op.obj2 is None
 867                assert op.indexes is None or isinstance(op.indexes, int)
 868                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='deleted')
 869                if text_diff is not None:
 870                    outputList.extend(text_diff)
 871                continue
 872
 873            # pitch
 874            if op.name == 'pitchnameedit':
 875                assert isinstance(op.obj1, AnnObject)
 876                assert isinstance(op.obj2, AnnObject)
 877                assert isinstance(op.indexes, tuple)  # both indices must be there
 878                assert len(op.indexes) == 2
 879                assert isinstance(op.indexes[0], int)
 880                assert isinstance(op.indexes[1], int)
 881                text_diff = vis_func(op, score1, score2, opname='changed', sub_name='pitch')
 882                if text_diff is not None:
 883                    outputList.extend(text_diff)

1287            )
1288
1289        if vis_type == 'draw':
1290            return None
1291
1292        # The rest of this is all about vis_type == 'text' and the outputList.
1293
1294        # Sort by measure number (int), then measure number suffix (str), then part
1295        # number, and then beat (as parsed from '@@ measure 3b, staff 2, beat 1.5 @@')
1296        # The goal is for all measure 0's to be printed first (with measure 0's staff 0
1297        # first), with the contents of each staff of each measure coming out in beat order.
1298        LOC_PATTERN: str = (
1299            r'\@\@ measure (\d+)(\w*), staff (\d+), beat (\d+|\d+[./]\d+|\d+ \d+/\d+) \@\@'
1300        )
1301        def measNum(s: str) -> int:
1302            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1303            if not m:
1304                return -1
1305            measNumStr: str = m.group(1)
1306            measNum: int = -1
1307            try:
1308                measNum = int(measNumStr)
1309            except Exception:
1310                pass
1311            return measNum
1312
1313        def measSuf(s: str) -> str:
1314            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1315            if not m:
1316                return ''
1317            measSuf: str = m.group(2)
1318            return measSuf
1319
1320        def staffNum(s: str) -> int:
1321            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1322            if not m:
1323                return -1
1324            staffNumStr: str = m.group(3)
1325            staffNum: int = -1
1326            try:
1327                staffNum = int(staffNumStr)
1328            except Exception:
1329                pass
1330            return staffNum
1331
1332        def beat(s: str) -> OffsetQL:
1333            # can be of the form 'j n/m' (mixed), 'n/m' (Fraction), or 'n.m' (float)
1334            m = re.match(LOC_PATTERN, s)
1335            if not m:
1336                return 0.
1337            beatStr: str = m.group(4)
1338            beats: OffsetQL = 0.
1339            beatsFrac: Fraction = Fraction(0, 1)
1340            beatsFloat: float = 0.
1341            try:
1342                if ' ' in beatStr and '/' in beatStr:
1343                    # mixed fraction 'j n/m'
1344                    nums: list[str] = beatStr.split(' ')
1345                    wholeNum: int = int(nums[0])
1346                    frac: Fraction = Fraction(nums[1])
1347                    beats = opFrac(wholeNum + frac)
1348                elif '/' in beatStr:
1349                    # fraction
1350                    beatsFrac = Fraction(beatStr)
1351                    beats = opFrac(beatsFrac)
1352                else:
1353                    beatsFloat = float(beatStr)
1354                    beats = opFrac(beatsFloat)
1355            except Exception:
1356                pass
1357            return beats
1358
1359        outputList.sort(key=lambda s: (measNum(s), measSuf(s), staffNum(s), beat(s)))
1360
1361        if op_list:
1362            # filenames only show up at the start of text output if there are any diffs
1363            if score1Name:
1364                outputList.insert(0, f'--- {score1Name}')
1365                outputList.insert(1, f'+++ {score2Name}')
1366            else:
1367                outputList.insert(0, '--- score1')
1368                outputList.insert(1, '+++ score2')
1369
1370        output = '\n'.join(outputList)
1371        return output
1372
1373    @staticmethod
1374    def get_omr_ned_output(
1375        omr_ed: int,
1376        annotated_predicted_score: AnnScore,
1377        annotated_ground_truth_score: AnnScore,
1378    ) -> dict[str, str]:
1379        num_syms_in_ground_truth: int = annotated_ground_truth_score.notation_size()
1380        num_syms_in_predicted: int = annotated_predicted_score.notation_size()
1381        omr_ned: float = Visualization.get_omr_ned(
1382            omr_ed, num_syms_in_predicted, num_syms_in_ground_truth
1383        )
1384        num_syms_in_both: int = num_syms_in_ground_truth + num_syms_in_predicted
1385        output: dict[str, str] = {
1386            'OMR-ED': f'{omr_ed}',
1387            'numSymbolsInPredicted': f'{num_syms_in_predicted}',
1388            'numSymbolsInGroundTruth': f'{num_syms_in_ground_truth}',
1389            'numSymbolsInBoth': f'{num_syms_in_both}',
1390            'OMR-NED': f'{omr_ned}',
1391        }
1392        return output
1393
1394    @staticmethod
1395    def get_omr_ned(
1396        omr_ed: int,
1397        num_syms_in_predicted: int,
1398        num_syms_in_ground_truth: int,
1399    ) -> float:
1400        num_syms_in_both: int = num_syms_in_ground_truth + num_syms_in_predicted
1401
1402        # Instead of divide by zero, return omr_ned == 0.0 (because both scores being
1403        # empty means they are exactly the same)
1404        omr_ned: float = 0.0
1405        if num_syms_in_both != 0:
1406            omr_ned = float(omr_ed) / float(num_syms_in_both)
1407        return omr_ned
1408
1409    @staticmethod
1410    def get_edit_distances_dict(
1411        op_list: list[DiffOperation],
1412        num_syntax_errors_fixed: int,
1413        detail: DetailLevel | int
1414    ) -> dict[str, int]:
1415        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1416
1417        edit_distances_dict: dict[str, int] = {}
1418        for op in op_list:
1419            edit_name: str = op.name
1420            if edit_name.startswith('extra'):
1421                extra: AnnObject | None = op.obj1 or op.obj2
1422                if extra is not None:
1423                    assert isinstance(extra, AnnExtra)
1424                    if extra.kind:
1425                        edit_name = re.sub('extra', extra.kind, edit_name)
1426
1427            if edit_name not in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1428                edit_name = 'directionins'  # default to direction
1429            name: str = Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME[edit_name]
1430
1431            omr_ed: int = op.edit_distance
1432            if name not in edit_distances_dict:
1433                edit_distances_dict[name] = omr_ed
1434            else:
1435                edit_distances_dict[name] = edit_distances_dict[name] + omr_ed
1436
1437        edit_distances_dict['bad kern syntax OMR-ED'] = num_syntax_errors_fixed
1438
1439        return edit_distances_dict
1440
1441    @staticmethod
1442    def create_header_names_once(detail: DetailLevel | int):
1443        if Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1444            return
1445
1446        if DetailLevel.includesVoicing(detail):
1447            Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME.update(
1448                Visualization._VOICING_HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME_EXTRAS
1449            )
1450
1451        ordered_names: list[str] = []
1452        for en in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1453            hn: str = Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME[en]
1454            if hn in ordered_names:
1455                continue
1456            ordered_names.append(hn)
1457            ordered_names.append(re.sub('OMR-ED', '% contribution to OMR-NED', hn))
1458
1459        Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES = ordered_names

1737    @staticmethod
1738    def get_output_csv_header(detail: DetailLevel | int) -> str:
1739        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1740
1741        header: str = ''
1742        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1743            header += ', '  # even at start of header (empty column, for 'Totals:' at the bottom)
1744            header += name
1745        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1746            header += ', '
1747            header += name
1748        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1749            header += ', '
1750            header += name
1751
1752        return header

1754    @staticmethod
1755    def get_output_csv_trailer(
1756        metrics_list: list[EvaluationMetrics],
1757        detail: DetailLevel | int
1758    ) -> str:
1759        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1760
1761        # Compute all the totals
1762        total_gt_numsyms: int = 0
1763        total_pred_numsyms: int = 0
1764        total_omr_edit_distance: int = 0
1765        total_edit_distances_dict: dict[str, int] = {}
1766
1767        for metrics in metrics_list:
1768            total_gt_numsyms += metrics.gt_numsyms
1769            total_pred_numsyms += metrics.pred_numsyms
1770            total_omr_edit_distance += metrics.omr_edit_distance
1771            for name in metrics.edit_distances_dict:
1772                if name not in total_edit_distances_dict:
1773                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] = metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1774                else:
1775                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] += metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1776
1777        total_numsyms: int = total_gt_numsyms + total_pred_numsyms
1778
1779        overall_omr_ned: float = Visualization.get_omr_ned(
1780            total_omr_edit_distance, total_pred_numsyms, total_gt_numsyms
1781        )
1782
1783        totals_line: str = 'Total:'  # the only thing in first column
1784
1785        # first the pre-edits fields
1786        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1787            totals_line += ', '
1788            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1789                pass  # leave empty
1790            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1791                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1792            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1793                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1794            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1795                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1796            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1797                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1798            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1799                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1800
1801        # then the edit fields
1802        previous_column_edit_distance: int = 0
1803        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1804            totals_line += ', '
1805            if name.endswith('OMR-ED'):
1806                if name in total_edit_distances_dict:
1807                    previous_column_edit_distance = total_edit_distances_dict[name]
1808                    totals_line += f'{total_edit_distances_dict[name]}'
1809                else:
1810                    previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1811                    totals_line += '0'
1812            elif name.endswith('% contribution to OMR-NED'):
1813                if previous_column_edit_distance:
1814                    contrib: float = (
1815                        float(previous_column_edit_distance * 100)
1816                        / float(total_omr_edit_distance)
1817                    )
1818                    totals_line += f'{contrib}'
1819                else:
1820                    totals_line += '0.'
1821                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1822            else:
1823                # how did we get here?
1824                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1825
1826
1827        # then the post-edits fields
1828        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1829            totals_line += ', '
1830            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1831                pass  # leave empty
1832            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1833                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1834            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1835                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1836            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1837                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1838            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1839                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1840            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1841                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1842
1843        repeated_header_line: str = Visualization.get_output_csv_header(detail)
1844
1845        trailer_line: str = totals_line + '\n' + repeated_header_line
1846        return trailer_line
1847
1848    @staticmethod
1849    def get_output_csv_line(
1850        metrics: EvaluationMetrics,
1851        detail: DetailLevel | int
1852    ) -> str:
1853        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1854
1855        # 888 could validate metrics.omr_edit_distance here (make sure it is the sum of
1856        # 888 everything in metrics.edit_distances_dict)
1857        total_numsyms: int = metrics.pred_numsyms + metrics.gt_numsyms
1858
1859        line: str = ''
1860
1861        # first the pre-edits fields
1862        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1863            line += ', '  # even at start of line (empty column, for 'Totals:' at the bottom)
1864            if name == 'gtpath':
1865                line += str(metrics.gt_path)
1866            elif name == 'predpath':
1867                line += str(metrics.pred_path)
1868            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1869                line += f'{metrics.gt_numsyms}'
1870            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1871                line += f'{metrics.pred_numsyms}'
1872            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1873                line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1874            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1875                line += f'{metrics.omr_edit_distance}'
1876            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1877                line += f'{metrics.omr_ned}'
1878
1879        # then the edit fields
1880        previous_column_edit_distance: int = 0
1881        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1882            line += ', '
1883            if name.endswith('OMR-ED'):
1884                if name in metrics.edit_distances_dict:
1885                    previous_column_edit_distance = metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1886                    line += f'{metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]}'
1887                else:
1888                    line += '0'
1889            elif name.endswith('% contribution to OMR-NED'):
1890                if previous_column_edit_distance:
1891                    contrib: float = (
1892                        float(previous_column_edit_distance * 100)
1893                        / float(metrics.omr_edit_distance)
1894                    )
1895                    line += (
1896                        f'{contrib}'
1897                    )
1898                else:
1899                    line += '0.'
1900                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1901            else:
1902                # how did we get here?
1903                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1904
1905        # then the post-edits fields
1906        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1907            line += ', '
1908            if name == 'gtpath':
1909                line += str(metrics.gt_path)
1910            elif name == 'predpath':
1911                line += str(metrics.pred_path)
1912            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1913                line += f'{metrics.gt_numsyms}'
1914            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1915                line += f'{metrics.pred_numsyms}'
1916            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1917                line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1918            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1919                line += f'{metrics.omr_edit_distance}'
1920            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1921                line += f'{metrics.omr_ned}'
1922
1923        return line

Arguments:

@staticmethod
def show_diffs( score1: music21.stream.base.Score, score2: music21.stream.base.Score, out_path1: str | pathlib.Path | None = None, out_path2: str | pathlib.Path | None = None) -> None: 
305    @staticmethod
306    def show_diffs(
307        score1: m21.stream.Score,
308        score2: m21.stream.Score,
309        out_path1: str | Path | None = None,
310        out_path2: str | Path | None = None
311    ) -> None:
312        '''
313        Render two (presumably marked-up) music21 scores.  If both out_path1 and
314        out_path2 are not None, save the rendered PDFs at those two locations,
315        otherwise just display them using the default PDF viewer on the system.
316
317        Args:
318            score1 (music21.stream.Score): The first score to render
319            score2 (music21.stream.Score): The second score to render
320            out_path1 (str, Path): Where to save the first marked-up rendered score PDF.
321                If out_path1 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
322                (default is None)
323            out_path2 (str, Path): Where to save the second marked-up rendered score PDF.
324                If out_path2 is None, both PDFs will be displayed in the default PDF viewer.
325                (default is None)
326        '''
327        # display the two (presumably annotated) scores
328
329        # avoid some crashes during write()/show() operations
330        from converter21 import M21Utilities
331        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score1, inPlace=True)
332        M21Utilities.fixupComplexHiddenRests(score2, inPlace=True)
333
334        originalComposer1: str | None = None
335        originalComposer2: str | None = None
336
337        if score1.metadata is None:
338            score1.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
339        if score2.metadata is None:
340            score2.metadata = m21.metadata.Metadata()
341
342        originalComposer1 = score1.metadata.composer
343        if originalComposer1 is None:
344            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1'
345        else:
346            score1.metadata.composer = 'score1          ' + originalComposer1
347
348        originalComposer2 = score2.metadata.composer
349        if originalComposer2 is None:
350            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2'
351        else:
352            score2.metadata.composer = 'score2          ' + originalComposer2
353
354        # save files if requested
355        if (out_path1 is not None) and (out_path2 is not None):
356            score1.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path1)
357            score2.write('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False, fp=out_path2)
358            print(f'Annotated scores saved in {out_path1} and {out_path2}.', file=sys.stderr)
359        else:
360            # just display the scores
361            score1.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)
362            score2.show('musicxml.pdf', makeNotation=False)

@staticmethod
def get_omr_ned( omr_ed: int, num_syms_in_predicted: int, num_syms_in_ground_truth: int) -> float: 
1394    @staticmethod
1395    def get_omr_ned(
1396        omr_ed: int,
1397        num_syms_in_predicted: int,
1398        num_syms_in_ground_truth: int,
1399    ) -> float:
1400        num_syms_in_both: int = num_syms_in_ground_truth + num_syms_in_predicted
1401
1402        # Instead of divide by zero, return omr_ned == 0.0 (because both scores being
1403        # empty means they are exactly the same)
1404        omr_ned: float = 0.0
1405        if num_syms_in_both != 0:
1406            omr_ned = float(omr_ed) / float(num_syms_in_both)
1407        return omr_ned
@staticmethod
def get_edit_distances_dict( op_list: list[musicdiff.comparison.DiffOperation], num_syntax_errors_fixed: int, detail: musicdiff.detaillevel.DetailLevel | int) -> dict[str, int]: 
1409    @staticmethod

1415        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)

1418        for op in op_list:

1420            if edit_name.startswith('extra'):
1421                extra: AnnObject | None = op.obj1 or op.obj2

1423                    assert isinstance(extra, AnnExtra)
1424                    if extra.kind:

1426
1427            if edit_name not in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1428                edit_name = 'directionins'  # default to direction

1430

1432            if name not in edit_distances_dict:
1433                edit_distances_dict[name] = omr_ed
1434            else:
1435                edit_distances_dict[name] = edit_distances_dict[name] + omr_ed
1436
1437        edit_distances_dict['bad kern syntax OMR-ED'] = num_syntax_errors_fixed
1438
1439        return edit_distances_dict
@staticmethod
def create_header_names_once(detail: musicdiff.detaillevel.DetailLevel | int): 
1441    @staticmethod
1442    def create_header_names_once(detail: DetailLevel | int):
1443        if Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1444            return
1445
1446        if DetailLevel.includesVoicing(detail):
1447            Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME.update(
1448                Visualization._VOICING_HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME_EXTRAS
1449            )
1450
1451        ordered_names: list[str] = []
1452        for en in Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME:
1453            hn: str = Visualization._HEADER_NAME_OF_EDIT_NAME[en]
1454            if hn in ordered_names:
1455                continue
1456            ordered_names.append(hn)
1457            ordered_names.append(re.sub('OMR-ED', '% contribution to OMR-NED', hn))
1458
1459        Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES = ordered_names

@staticmethod
def get_output_csv_trailer( metrics_list: list[musicdiff.comparison.EvaluationMetrics], detail: musicdiff.detaillevel.DetailLevel | int) -> str: 
1754    @staticmethod
1755    def get_output_csv_trailer(
1756        metrics_list: list[EvaluationMetrics],
1757        detail: DetailLevel | int
1758    ) -> str:
1759        Visualization.create_header_names_once(detail)
1760
1761        # Compute all the totals
1762        total_gt_numsyms: int = 0
1763        total_pred_numsyms: int = 0
1764        total_omr_edit_distance: int = 0
1765        total_edit_distances_dict: dict[str, int] = {}
1766
1767        for metrics in metrics_list:
1768            total_gt_numsyms += metrics.gt_numsyms
1769            total_pred_numsyms += metrics.pred_numsyms
1770            total_omr_edit_distance += metrics.omr_edit_distance
1771            for name in metrics.edit_distances_dict:
1772                if name not in total_edit_distances_dict:
1773                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] = metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1774                else:
1775                    total_edit_distances_dict[name] += metrics.edit_distances_dict[name]
1776
1777        total_numsyms: int = total_gt_numsyms + total_pred_numsyms
1778
1779        overall_omr_ned: float = Visualization.get_omr_ned(
1780            total_omr_edit_distance, total_pred_numsyms, total_gt_numsyms
1781        )
1782
1783        totals_line: str = 'Total:'  # the only thing in first column
1784
1785        # first the pre-edits fields
1786        for name in Visualization._PRE_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1787            totals_line += ', '
1788            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1789                pass  # leave empty
1790            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1791                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1792            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1793                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1794            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1795                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1796            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1797                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1798            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1799                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1800
1801        # then the edit fields
1802        previous_column_edit_distance: int = 0
1803        for name in Visualization._ORDERED_HEADER_NAMES:
1804            totals_line += ', '
1805            if name.endswith('OMR-ED'):
1806                if name in total_edit_distances_dict:
1807                    previous_column_edit_distance = total_edit_distances_dict[name]
1808                    totals_line += f'{total_edit_distances_dict[name]}'
1809                else:
1810                    previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1811                    totals_line += '0'
1812            elif name.endswith('% contribution to OMR-NED'):
1813                if previous_column_edit_distance:
1814                    contrib: float = (
1815                        float(previous_column_edit_distance * 100)
1816                        / float(total_omr_edit_distance)
1817                    )
1818                    totals_line += f'{contrib}'
1819                else:
1820                    totals_line += '0.'
1821                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1822            else:
1823                # how did we get here?
1824                previous_column_edit_distance = 0
1825
1826
1827        # then the post-edits fields
1828        for name in Visualization._POST_EDITS_HEADER_NAMES:
1829            totals_line += ', '
1830            if name in ('gtpath', 'predpath'):
1831                pass  # leave empty
1832            elif name == 'gt numsyms':
1833                totals_line += f'{total_gt_numsyms}'
1834            elif name == 'pred numsyms':
1835                totals_line += f'{total_pred_numsyms}'
1836            elif name == 'total numsyms (in both scores)':
1837                totals_line += f'{total_numsyms}'
1838            elif name == 'OMR-ED (OMR Edit Distance)':
1839                totals_line += f'{total_omr_edit_distance}'
1840            elif name == 'OMR-NED (OMR-ED / total numsyms)':
1841                totals_line += f'{overall_omr_ned}'
1842
1843        repeated_header_line: str = Visualization.get_output_csv_header(detail)
1844
1845        trailer_line: str = totals_line + '\n' + repeated_header_line
1846        return trailer_line
